system.description:
You cannot target yourself with this skill. The target may immediately perform one [Timing: Major] action with the [Weapon Attack] [Magic Attack] or [Special Attack] tag. You assume the [Hate] cost of the target's action.

(Fate 1): Reduce the assumed [Hate] cost by -2 (minimum 0).

A special skill that makes allies move and attack with a repetitive rhythm. As the commander of the battlefield, you are a threat in the eyes of your enemies.
